description: Cosine-similarity Proxy-Anchor objective with separate positive and negative log-sum-exp aggregation (Kim et al., §§3.1–3.2, Eqs. (4)–(5); paper.txt:181-247; clean-room implementation in src/topologies/implementations/losses/proxy_anchor.py:7-97).

examples.title: Train embeddings with learnable class proxies

name: Proxy Anchor Loss

parameters.additional parameters: proxies, alpha, and delta are accepted in **params; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.alpha: finite positive scale factor (default 32.0; Kim et al. §4.2)
parameters.delta: finite nonnegative margin (default 0.1; Kim et al. §§4.2–4.3)
parameters.ignore_index: optional integer class label whose samples are excluded before forming positive and negative sets; at least one sample must remain
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point embeddings shaped [B,D] with B,D > 0; embeddings are L2-normalized along D before cosine similarity
parameters.proxies: required finite floating-point caller-owned/trainable class proxies shaped [C,D], with C,D > 0 and the same dtype and device as embeddings
parameters.reduction: none returns C per-proxy contributions scaled so their mean equals the paper objective; mean averages them and sum totals them (default mean)
parameters.targets: integer class IDs shaped [B] in [0,C); finite integral-valued floating-point labels are also accepted
